title: Usage Stats

summary.estCostTooltip: API-equivalent conversion. Since the account uses a subscription, the real cost is a fixed subscription fee, not billed per token.

action.resetDone: Reset done — deleted {runs} run(s), cleared {usage} usage record(s).

storage.title: Storage
storage.note: Read-only. To free space, delete sessions in History; that removes the session's Devdy log, fetched issue/PR files and Claude/Codex CLI transcripts together. Token stats are kept.

resetModal.title: Reset usage statistics
resetModal.line1: This will delete all old runs (including their logs and Claude/Codex CLI transcripts) and reset every statistic to 0.
